Yellow enters the cargo bay area, eyes scanning the shelves. The trombone lies on a crate, partially hidden by a stack of crates.

Yellow places the trombone under their chin, making a series of awkward and hilarious notes. The spaceship's speakers amplify the sounds, causing nearby crewmates to look up in surprise.
